newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan dollar closes lower on political concerns.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan dollar closes lower on political concerns.

text.p: The Taiwan dollar closed lower against the U.S. dollar on Friday on domestic political uncertainty following the resignation of three cabinet ministers, dealers said.
But the fall was limited by the greenback's sharp depreciation overseas, dealers added.
The local unit ended at T$27.685 against Thursday's T$27.680 close.
Turnover through dealers was an active US$351.5 million.

Minister without portfolio Ma Ying-jeou, Interior Minister Lin Feng-cheng and agriculture council chairman Tjiu Mau-ying resigned on Thursday as anti-government sentiment deepened over a recent spate of violent crimes and other issues.
"The three ministers' resignations drew some investors to the U.S. dollar," said one dealer at a foreign bank.
"But the greenback was held back by its weakness overseas," she added.
Dealers said they expected a narrow range of T$27.66-70 for Saturday. -- Kevin Chen (5080815)
